summary: Star Realms: Frontiers is a standalone entry in the fast, combative Star Realms deckbuilding line, where players buy ships and bases from a shared trade row and use them to pummel each other's Authority down to zero. This version adds solo and cooperative scenarios alongside the usual head-to-head duels.
praised: extremely fast, tight deckbuilding with almost no downtime
great value and portability for the depth it offers
solo/co-op modes add welcome variety to the format
criticised: doesn't innovate much beyond the core Star Realms formula
card draw luck can swing individual games
combat can feel a bit swingy at low player counts

interaction.detail: Players draw from the same shared trade row to build their decks, then attack each other's Authority directly with combat, so both the acquisition pool and the damage race are constantly shared and contested. There's little parallel play — every turn is aimed at either building your deck or hurting your opponent.

scoring.why: There's no points salad — the only thing tracked is each player's Authority total.
scoring.how_you_win: You win by building a deck of ships and bases efficient enough to reduce your opponent's Authority to zero before they do the same to you.
